acceptance: Uploaded and downloaded counters persist per remote identity.
validation: cargo test -p raria-ed2k --test credits --locked and cargo test -p raria-core ed2k_credit_rows_roundtrip_by_profile --locked
evidence: PeerCreditStore accumulates nonzero uploaded/downloaded byte counters by ED2K user hash, roundtrips native snapshots, and raria-core stores versioned NativeEd2kCreditRow records in redb by profile id.

acceptance: Credit score influences waiting queue order within bounded fair limits.
evidence: UploadQueue owns PeerCreditStore and uses bounded score_ratio ordering for waiting peers while preserving active-slot priority and deterministic endpoint tie breaks.

acceptance: Secure identification remains unadvertised unless public-key and signature flow is fully implemented.
evidence: PeerCapabilities::local still advertises secure_ident_version 0 and no crypt-layer requirement/request/support because raria has no public-key and signature secure-ident flow yet.
